story.title: GitHub Copilot drops unlimited AI coding plan and shifts to metered billing as costs spiral
story.summary: Microsoft's GitHub is ending its flat-rate unlimited AI offering for Copilot customers, moving to a metered billing model that charges developers based on actual AI usage. The company acknowledged it can no longer sustain the all-you-can-eat pricing model as AI inference costs mount. The change will directly affect millions of developers worldwide who have come to rely on Copilot for daily coding assistance, and signals a broader industry reckoning with the true cost of AI productivity tools.
